verdict.rationale: Unity has publicly canceled its per-install Runtime Fee, so the no-per-install-fee part holds. The license is still proprietary and revenue-gated: the free Personal plan applies only under $100K in revenue and funds raised, and studios above that pay seat costs. Community reports describe unilateral forced license upgrades, doubled costs, and terms that 'can change at any moment', which is the opposite of a permissive license. Missing for 10: a permissive or open license, a documented guarantee of no royalties or revenue share, free use above the $100K threshold, and stable terms protected from unilateral change.
